# devin_enterprise_service_user_api_key (Resource)

Creates an API key for an existing enterprise service user. The token is only returned at creation and is stored in state. Every attribute forces a replacement, which creates the new key before revoking the old one when combined with create_before_destroy. A key that is revoked or expires outside Terraform is removed from state and recreated on the next apply. Requires the ManageAccountServiceUsers permission at the enterprise level. Cannot be imported.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "devin_service_users" "all" {}

locals {
  metrics_service_user_id = one([
    for su in data.devin_service_users.all.service_users : su.service_user_id
    if su.name == "Metrics Exporter"
  ])
}

# Replace the key every 30 days. Each key expires after 60 days, so a missed
# apply leaves the current key working.
resource "time_rotating" "metrics_key" {
  rotation_days = 30
}

resource "devin_enterprise_service_user_api_key" "metrics" {
  service_user_id = local.metrics_service_user_id
  name            = "metrics-exporter-${formatdate("YYYY-MM-DD", time_rotating.metrics_key.id)}"
  expires_at      = time_rotating.metrics_key.unix + 60 * 24 * 60 * 60

  lifecycle {
    create_before_destroy = true
  }
}

# Pass the token to the consumer, e.g. a secret manager version.
output "metrics_token" {
  value     = devin_enterprise_service_user_api_key.metrics.token
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the API key.
- `service_user_id` (String) ID of an existing service user (prefix: service-user-).

### Optional

- `expires_at` (Number) Expiration as a UNIX timestamp in seconds. Must be in the future. Omit for a key that does not expire.

### Read-Only

- `api_key_id` (String) API key ID (assigned by Devin).
- `created_at` (Number) Creation time as a UNIX timestamp in seconds.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) The raw API key (cog_ prefix). Only returned by the API at creation.
